changelog: AniPlay v1.6.0 — Mega Release (Realtime Comment Alerts, Airing Push Engine, Multi-Part Matcher & Glass UI)
changelogItems: 🔔 YouTube-Style Notification System: In-app Bell with live unread badge, dedicated inbox tabs (All, Releases, Reminders), and native Android status bar alerts
💬 Realtime Comment & Like Alerts: Instant notifications when someone likes your comments or replies to your discussion in the community
🎬 Universal Multi-Part & Season Stream Matcher: Seamless playback support for complex titled anime (e.g. 86 Part 2, Roman numerals, number-word titles) via Cloudflare KV slug map
🎨 Tactile Liquid Glass Header: Fixed icon transparency on mobile tap; navigation pills remain solid and responsive with haptic scaling
🛡️ Anti-Random-Anime Shield & DUB Parity: Precision keyword coverage guarantees 100% correct streams and downloads across AniNeko, AniKoto, and AniWaves
🧊 GPU Decoder Freeze Watchdog: Hardware-level recovery prevents video freezing while audio continues playing on weak decoders
✨ Butter-Smooth 120Hz Animations: Fluid visionOS/iOS 18 glassmorphism, zero-jitter transitions, and persistent orientation locks
